body.text: Plaintiff [NAME], pro se, moves the Court for an Order [SPECIFIC RELIEF], pursuant to Wis. Stat. § [___]. Plaintiff files contemporaneously a Brief in Support and supporting exhibits identifying the specific deficiencies, the controlling legal standards, and the relief requested.
1. [First form of relief, stated as an order the Court can sign];
2. In addition or in the alternative, [second form of relief]; and
3. Granting whatever other relief justice requires. Wis. Stat. § [___].
[Optional timeliness / procedural posture paragraph. The grounds for the motion are set out in the Brief in Support, which is incorporated into this motion.]
WHEREFORE, Plaintiff respectfully requests that the Court enter an order [relief, matching the opening paragraph], and granting such other and further relief as the Court deems just and proper.
